description: Fixed 10-prompt evaluation set for BlinkBuild (P13-T1: 3 UI-only, 3 backend-only, 4 full-stack including 2 auth-related).

prompts.prompt: Build a sleek SaaS landing page for an analytics tool with a hero section, 3-tier pricing table, and FAQ accordion.
Create a responsive photography portfolio gallery with category filter tabs and a lightbox modal.
expected_acceptance_points: Clicking an image opens and closes the lightbox modal

prompts.prompt: Build a Pomodoro focus timer web app with start/pause/reset controls and customizable work/break durations.
expected_acceptance_points: Timer counts down when started and pauses cleanly

prompts.prompt: Create a Node.js REST API for a URL shortener with POST /shorten and GET /:code redirect plus in-memory click counts.
expected_acceptance_points: GET /:code redirects or returns 404 for unknown code

prompts.prompt: Build an Express API for an expense tracker with GET /expenses, POST /expenses validation, and monthly totals.
expected_acceptance_points: GET /expenses returns list and aggregated total

prompts.prompt: Create a Node.js authentication API with POST /api/login issuing signed tokens and GET /api/me returning 401 when unauthenticated.
expected_acceptance_points: Missing or invalid token returns 401 on GET /api/me

prompts.prompt: Build a full-stack Kanban board with React columns/cards and a Node API to create, move, and delete tasks.
expected_acceptance_points: Frontend calls contract routes for task CRUD
Moving a card persists across reload

prompts.prompt: Create a full-stack polling app with React UI to create polls/vote and a Node backend storing vote counts.
expected_acceptance_points: Submitting a vote updates percentages via API

prompts.prompt: Build a full-stack notes app with a login screen, protected API routes, and per-user note creation.
expected_acceptance_points: Signed-in user can create and list notes

prompts.prompt: Create a full-stack team issue tracker with sign-in, role-gated admin settings endpoint (403 for non-admin), and issue status filtering.
